[[File:Turning Point title card.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Title card. Still: [[Brandon Baity]].]]
'''''Turning Point''''' is a 2016 ''Star Wars'' fan film directed and edited by [[Brandon Baity]]. It was an entry in the 2016 Star Wars Fan Film Contest.<ref name="film" /><ref name="teaser" />

Tom Andersen and Brandon Baity wrote the film and were its directors of photography. Cast: Nic Stevens (Joran), TJ Strickland (Nahru), Anthony Nelson (Morg), and Christie Quinn (Seema). Zachary Weitzel is credited for armor; Indira Nauth as production assistant and audio. The short runs 7 minutes 9 seconds.<ref name="film" />
